name: 06357 · Niantic, CT
findings: ZIP 06357 (Niantic) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06357 (Niantic) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
